description: This PHP class `ProjectReportData` generates project report data, normalizing project activities and related metadata for reporting purposes within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It interacts with project services, formats data, and provides report-specific metadata.

classes.name: ProjectReportData
classes.description: A class that prepares and normalizes project report data and associated metadata for use in the OrangeHRM reporting system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the report data object with specific search filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of project activities with details and URLs for reporting.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the project report, including total durations, counts, and project details.
